telegram._comment: Credentials live in secrets.json (this machine) or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (GitHub Actions). Not here.

_comment_gates: HARD GATES. Any single failure = token is rejected, no alert. Loosen at your own risk.
_comment_momentum: max_price_change_h24_pct rejects tokens that already made their move - a clean token up 790% in a day is a safe way to buy the top. Set to null or 0 to disable the gate.
_comment_scoring: Tokens that clear every gate are scored 0-100. Only >= min_score_to_alert is sent.
_comment_github: Where the cloud scans run. status.py and /status read this repo's public Actions API so they can tell you what the cloud is doing, not just this laptop.
_comment_social: Social scoring is age- and activity-checked, not presence-checked. X account age, follower and post counts come from api.vxtwitter.com; domain registration date comes from RDAP. Both are free and keyless. A days-old account earns nothing - almost every meme coin has one - but an established account or domain is hard to fake in a hurry. Basis for the Telegram weight: arXiv:2607.02823, Cox HR 5.40 over 832,941 launches.

social_gates._comment_ages: Age gates are OFF by default (0): nearly every legitimate meme coin launches with a fresh account, so gating on age rejects everything. The ages are scored and printed instead. Set a number to gate.

_comment_composite: Final = safety_weight*on-chain safety + social_weight*social score. On-chain quality decides; social breaks ties. min_safety_score is a hard floor applied BEFORE the blend, so a weak-on-chain token cannot be carried in by a large chat room.
_comment_insider: max_insider_network_pct: share of supply held by wallet clusters RugCheck has linked together - a bundled launch looks distributed to a top-10 check but is not. max_creator_tokens: 0 = off, because RugCheck populates creatorTokens for only some tokens; set it and unknown deployers are still allowed through, never assumed clean.
